rca of the issue: React duplicate key warning: Dashboard.jsx auto-start useEffect fires twice in React 18 StrictMode (dev). autoStarted.current guard sets true on the first call but the second useEffect invocation runs before React commits the ref mutation? Actually the ref mutation is synchronous — however BOTH run() calls also share the setRunning(true) which is async, so on second sync invocation `running` is still false and the `if (running) return` guard passes. Both invocations then reset logCounter.current=0 and start two SSE streams whose interleaved pushLog() calls generate the same log-1/log-2/log-3 ids in the concatenated log array. Reproduction: open dashboard for a fresh project in dev build → observe hundreds of 'Encountered two children with the same key, log-3' warnings in browser console. Mitigation: (a) synchronously set a `startedRef.current = true` at the top of run() and early-return if already true; or (b) key logs by monotonic Date.now()+random rather than a resettable counter.
